user.title: Automatic Dashboard
user.description: Adds Automatic Dashboard and its theme. The dashboard builds itself from your devices, rooms and floors.

data.par_defaut: Make it the default dashboard for everyone

data_description.creer_tableau: It appears in the sidebar as soon as Home Assistant is reloaded.
data_description.par_defaut: Everyone lands on it when opening Home Assistant. You can change it later in Settings, Dashboards.

themes_non_charges.title: The Automatic Dashboard theme could not be loaded
themes_non_charges.description:
Automatic Dashboard works, but without its colors. To get them back, add these two lines to configuration.yaml, then restart Home Assistant:

```yaml
frontend:
  themes: !include_dir_merge_named themes
```
